description: Look up the full European road dangerous-goods (ADR 2025) Table A entry for a substance — all 20 columns, from class, packing group and labels through special provisions, limited/excepted quantities, packing instructions, tank codes, carriage provisions, transport category, tunnel restriction code and hazard identification number — and what each of those codes means (resolved_codes). 2,939 entries across all 9 classes, from UNECE ADR 2025. Provide exactly ONE of: un_number (every packing-group variant of it; "1203", "UN1203" and "un 1203" are equivalent; explosives keep their leading zero), search (partial proper shipping name), hazard_class, or un_numbers (batch). A search with no hits errors with the closest names. For an LQ/EQ quantity check use adr_lq_eq_check; for 1.1.3.6 small-load points adr_exemption_calculator; for an identifier of unknown kind resolve_reference. Editions: edition ("2025" | "2027") and as_of (YYYY-MM-DD) choose the ADR edition — edition wins, else the date picks it (ADR 2025 before 2027-01-01, ADR 2027 from then; ADR 2025 may still be applied until 2027-06-30). An answer on a named edition carries adr_edition; neither sent, the answer is ADR 2025 until 2027-01-01. edition ("2025" | "2027") and as_of choose the ADR edition; neither sent, ADR 2025 until 2027-01-01. Rate-limited: a limit error carries reset_at, the UTC time the allowance resets. A factual compilation of the ADR table, not legal or compliance advice; classification remains the consignor's responsibility.

as_of.description: The date the answer is for, YYYY-MM-DD (default today, UTC).

edition.description: ADR edition; wins over as_of. Omitted: as_of picks it.

hazard_class.description: All entries in an ADR class (Table A column (3a)), e.g. "3", "6.1", "1" (explosives; "1.4S" is a classification_code).

include_codes.description: What each Table A code means (resolved_codes): compact, full or none. Default compact for un_number, none otherwise. Each meaning carries verification_status (e.g. paraphrase_unreviewed).

include_statements.description: true adds plain-word statements[] to every row. Default false.

limit.description: search / hazard_class only: rows per page (default and max 50 for a search, 100 for a class).

offset.description: search / hazard_class only: rows to skip (default 0). The response gives total and next_offset.

search.description: Case-insensitive partial match on the proper shipping name (min 2 characters). Example: "acetone".

un_number.description: Exact UN number, 4 digits, optionally "UN"-prefixed ("0004" keeps its zero).

un_numbers.description: Batch: up to 50 UN numbers. Send alone.

name: adr_lookup
title: ADR Dangerous Goods Lookup
